name: cuda4cpu
title: cuda4cpu
description: Compile, run and test CUDA and HIP programs on the CPU, unmodified, without a GPU, and find the bugs a GPU hides at their source lines: missing __syncthreads(), races between thread orders, out-of-bounds accesses, reads of uninitialized memory and leaks. The tools take sources inline, so the server needs no host files, credentials or network: its image includes the compilers.
